title.en: How B500S-83D Prints Manual and Electric

description.en: The B500S-83D type line says two-stage, manual / electric. Only one motor power and one voltage are printed.
description.zh: B500S-83D 的型式行写两级结构、手动/电动。电机功率和电压只各印了一个。

h1.en: How B500S-83D Prints Manual and Electric

directAnswer.en: B500S-83D is a compact concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Its type cell says two-stage structure pump, manual / electric. Motor power is 7.5 kW and rated voltage is 380 V. The page does not print a second power for manual operation, and it does not print an output in m³/h. Vertical and horizontal delivery are each 5 m. The words manual / electric are a type line, not two complete specification tables.
directAnswer.zh: B500S-83D 是河北品锦机械在邢台的紧凑型混凝土泵。型式格写两级结构泵，手动/电动。电机功率 7.5 kW，额定电压 380 V。页面没有为手动运行再印一个功率，也没有印以 m³/h 计的产量。垂直和水平输送都是 5 m。手动/电动是型式行，不是两套完整规格表。

body.en: 7.5 kW is the motor-power figure. 380 V is the rated voltage. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print a manual-mode kilowatt beside them. Do not invent one.
body.zh: 7.5 kW 是电机功率。380 V 是额定电压。河北品锦机械没有在旁边再印一个手动档千瓦。不要编造。

body.en: Vertical delivery height is 5 m and horizontal delivery distance is 5 m. There is not a manual distance and an electric distance. Weight is 280 kg and the outline is 915 × 550 × 550 mm.
body.zh: 垂直输送高度 5 m，水平输送距离 5 m。没有一个手动距离再加一个电动距离。重量 280 kg，外形 915 × 550 × 550 mm。

body.en: Applicable materials are sand and small stone, 5–16 mm. Delivery hose is printed as Standard, not as a millimetre diameter. Those cells also are not split by manual and electric.
body.zh: 适用材料是砂与小石，5–16 mm。输送胶管印的是标准，不是毫米管径。这些格子也没有按手动和电动拆开。

question.en: Does manual mode have its own kilowatt figure?
question.zh: 手动模式有自己的千瓦数吗？

answer.en: No. The page prints 7.5 kW once.
answer.zh: 没有。页面只印一次 7.5 kW。

answer.en: B500S-83D does not print a theoretical output in m³/h.
answer.zh: B500S-83D 没有印以 m³/h 表示的理论输送量。

answer.en: No. Both directions are 5 m, printed once.
answer.zh: 没有。两个方向都是 5 m，只印一次。
